I'd stay away from it. DMAA is a stimulant that has been banned or restricted in many countries and by most sports bodies, and it's been pulled from legitimate supplements because of cardiovascular safety concerns. Products that still carry it tend to be unregulated, so you can't trust what's in the tub.

As for whether any preworkout is worth it, a solid night's sleep, a meal a couple of hours before, and a good warm-up do most of what those products promise. Anything stimulant-based is one to run past a doctor or dietitian, since I can't speak to what's safe for you.

If energy is the issue, tell me when in the day you train and how you're sleeping, and we can look at the training side.
